claims.summary: For each fixed maximum degree Delta, every n-vertex m-edge simple oriented graph with nonzero total ternary charge has a noncommutative IPS formula over F2 of size O_Delta((n+m+1)^4) and binary-fan-in depth O_Delta(log(n+m+2)) for the original one-hot Tseitin CNF plus all Boolean and variable-commutator generators. The formula is placeholder-linear and satisfies both identities in the free algebra. Local Boolean interpolation, paid adjacent swaps, vertex telescoping and balanced F4 coordinate descent supply the full tree cost. No fixed-depth Frege refutation or lower bound follows.
